entities.summary: Oliver Gardner Drake is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He has played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Baltimore Orioles, Milwaukee Brewers, Cleveland Guardians, Los Angeles Angels, Toronto Blue Jays, Minnesota Twins and Tampa Bay Rays.
